column1: # Single source of truth for both installers. install.ps1 and install.sh read this
# file, so adding a skill or an external plugin is one edit, not two.
# Columns, in order, separated by a literal pipe:
#   kind | name | source | spec | verifiedHost | description
# kind = local     Shipped in this repo. `source` is the directory at the repo root
#                  that gets copied into the skills root.
# kind = external  Lives in someone else's open-source repo. Nothing is vendored:
#                  the installer prints `source` (the repo URL) plus the commands
# spec          npm package spec for external entries; "-" for local ones.
# verifiedHost  The DSH version `spec` was verified against; "-" for local ones.
# description   One line, no pipe characters.
local|ship|ship|-|-|End-to-end delivery: grill, spec, tickets, test-first build, review, close-out (/ship only)
local|grilling|grilling|-|-|Interviews you about a plan until nothing is silently assumed
local|tdd|tdd|-|-|Red-green loop at agreed seams, plus the anti-patterns that make tests worthless
local|diagnosing-bugs|diagnosing-bugs|-|-|Bounded diagnosis loop gated on a feedback loop that goes red
external|dsh-ops|https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops|dsh-ops@0.4.1|0.2.1-rc.3|DSH low-level tool surface: compact file and discovery tools, PTC batch API
external|dsh-connect-workbuddy|https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy|dsh-connect-workbuddy@5.12.1|0.2.1-rc.3|Connects a locally signed-in WorkBuddy account to DSH as a model provider
